observations.note: Step 8 asked for one edit of the plan marking all rows, but the session made seven separate edits to the plan, one per row.
No search of the spec folders for behaviours of the changed source files appears after the code edits, so the step 7 check for specs outside the plan was not shown.

Step 3: write tests first and see them fail for the right reason
Step 4: smallest code change that makes the tests pass
Step 6: run only the test files the rows name, as plain commands
Step 7: check specs the plan does not name
Step 8: one edit of the plan for all completed marks
Limits: no commit or push, plain single commands
Hand over: end with ARTIFACT phase_note line
